IN_SCOPE: integration reservation interlock required to make those transitions exclusive
OUT_OF_SCOPE: RESOURCE_GRAPH_UPDATE semantics already governed by clause [119]

AUTHORITY_BASIS: [039]-[041] every Mission Fence mutation is expected-STATE_VERSION CAS and increments STATE_VERSION
[045] only one normal global transition at a time
[119] establishes ACTIVE_INTEGRATION==null and HEALTHY as an existing safety pattern for a global graph transition
[132]-[145] integration intent/reservation and Git-truth crash recovery
[153]-[160] Constitution/Spec activation close gates and invalidate old epochs
[238] old-law and new-law mutation authority must never overlap

PRE_ENTRY_RULE.RULE: CONSTITUTION_ACTIVATION or SPEC_ACTIVATION MUST NOT enter while ACTIVE_INTEGRATION is non-null or INTEGRATION_HEALTH is not HEALTHY.
PRE_ENTRY_RULE.FAILURE_ACTION: KEEP ACTIVATION PENDING; process the old-generation integration/recovery under the currently active law until terminal, reconciled, and cleared. Do not install the new law/spec identity.

ACTIVE_PHASE_HANDLING.RESERVED: Do not activate. Complete authorized cancellation/release or continue old-law integration to a terminal reconciled outcome, then clear ACTIVE_INTEGRATION.
ACTIVE_PHASE_HANDLING.REF_UPDATE_PENDING: Do not activate. Resolve or cancel under old-law authority before any cutover.
ACTIVE_PHASE_HANDLING.REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS: Reconcile actual target HEAD using clauses [143]-[145]. Activation remains blocked until Git truth is classified and ACTIVE_INTEGRATION is terminal and cleared.
ACTIVE_PHASE_HANDLING.COMMITTED_PENDING_VERIFICATION: Verify the committed candidate under old-law binding. Activation remains blocked until verification/recovery completes and ACTIVE_INTEGRATION is cleared.
ACTIVE_PHASE_HANDLING.VERIFIED: Persist terminal evidence and clear ACTIVE_INTEGRATION with an authoritative Mission Fence CAS before activation entry.
ACTIVE_PHASE_HANDLING.REGRESSION: Keep INTEGRATION_HEALTH=REGRESSION and execute authorized rollback/forward-fix recovery before activation.
ACTIVE_PHASE_HANDLING.UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION: Fail closed. Reconcile actual target HEAD; never infer or erase Git truth.

ATOMIC_ENTRY_CAS.READ_SNAPSHOT: Read the complete current MISSION_FENCE_STATE and actual target HEAD before constructing transition intent.
CAS_PRECONDITIONS: STATE_VERSION equals the snapshot expected version
the requested transition intent binds the current mission/law/spec/generation state
ATOMIC_ENTRY_CAS.CAS_FAILURE: No transition authority is acquired. Re-read state and restart from pre-entry evaluation.

INTEGRATION_RESERVATION_INTERLOCK.RULE: Any ACTIVE_INTEGRATION reservation CAS MUST require the same snapshot to have TRANSITION_KIND==NONE and INTEGRATION_GATE==OPEN in addition to existing mission/epoch/intent eligibility.
INTEGRATION_RESERVATION_INTERLOCK.WHY: The activation entry CAS and integration reservation CAS contend on the same monotonically increasing STATE_VERSION. Exactly one can win from a given snapshot; the loser must resync.
INTEGRATION_RESERVATION_INTERLOCK.FORBIDDEN: Do not reserve ACTIVE_INTEGRATION after an activation entry has closed INTEGRATION_GATE or while TRANSITION_KIND is non-NONE.

TARGET_HEAD_CUTOVER_FENCE.TARGET_HEAD_AT_INTENT: Immutable value bound into activation transition intent.
BEFORE_IDENTITY_INSTALL: Require all three gates remain CLOSED.
TARGET_HEAD_CUTOVER_FENCE.HEAD_MISMATCH_ACTION: Set transition state to BLOCKED_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED via expected-version CAS, keep all gates CLOSED, preserve actual Git truth, and reconcile before proceeding.
TARGET_HEAD_CUTOVER_FENCE.PROHIBITION: Never install new EFFECTIVE_CONSTITUTION_HASH/SPEC_ARTIFACT_HASH activation generation across an unexplained target-head change.

IDENTITY_INSTALL_RULE.CONSTITUTION_ACTIVATION: New EFFECTIVE_CONSTITUTION_HASH and CONSTITUTION_ACTIVATION_GENERATION may become ACTIVE only after the interlock and target-head cutover fence pass.
IDENTITY_INSTALL_RULE.SPEC_ACTIVATION: New SPEC_ARTIFACT_HASH and SPEC_ACTIVATION_GENERATION may become ACTIVE only after the interlock and target-head cutover fence pass.
IDENTITY_INSTALL_RULE.OLD_AUTHORITY: Old membership/lease authority remains invalidated by the entry epoch increments, but no already-issued Git ref effect is assumed cancelled merely by epoch rotation.

CRASH_RECOVERY.AFTER_ENTRY_BEFORE_INSTALL: Resume from durable transition state with gates CLOSED. Re-read Mission Fence and actual target HEAD; do not recreate or skip the intent.
CRASH_RECOVERY.USER_STOP: USER_STOP may preempt; preserve ACTIVE_INTEGRATION identity, actual Git result, transition identity, and recovery evidence.

REQUIRED_TORTURE_MATRIX: activation request racing ACTIVE_INTEGRATION reservation from same STATE_VERSION
activation while REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS before Git CAS
activation crash concurrent with successful Git CAS
unexpected target HEAD change after transition entry and before identity install
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: No execution path permits new-law/new-spec identity installation while an old-generation ACTIVE_INTEGRATION is non-null.
A transition-entry CAS and integration-reservation CAS from the same STATE_VERSION cannot both succeed.
REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS crash boundaries always reconcile against actual target HEAD before cutover.
Any target HEAD mismatch during activation keeps gates closed and requires reconciliation.
Independent review confirms compatibility with clauses [039]-[045], [132]-[160], and [238]-[245].
